what: Two tape lines, one of text and one of bold bands, cross in an X (front band -3.6°, back band +3.6°) and flow endlessly in opposite directions — at 1440 width the text line moves 36.7px per second and the bold band 148.5px (proportional to board width). Stops when offscreen. For bands cutting across section boundaries.

options.[data-fx-part=strip]: Band (two children) — first is front (-tilt°, to the left), second is back (+tilt°, to the right)
options.[data-fx-part=row]: Line inside the band — content is doubled and looped. data-key="band" Thick surface band, color opposite to the speed
options.tilt: Tilt (deg), default 3.6 — 0 means side by side
options.thin: Text line speed (px/s at 1440 width), default 36.7
options.band: Thick band speed (px/s at 1440 width), default 148.5
